name: janitor-discover
tagline_zh: 装新技能前先扫一眼：GitHub 搜罗、查重、看安全风险。别人踩过的坑，你一眼看穿，再决定装不装。
tagline_en: Before you install, scan GitHub for skills, check overlap and risk. See the traps others hit—then decide.
desc_en: Find new skills on GitHub or check a specific skill before installing. Use when the user wants to search for skills, evaluate a skill URL, check overlap and security risk before installing, or compare a local skill against alternatives. Trigger with '/janitor-discover'.
why_zh: 同类只搜不评，它连本地技能和替代品都对比，把安全风险摊开，装前先排雷。
why_en: Others only search; it compares local skills and alternatives, exposing security risks before you commit.
